hook: Russia and Ukraine: back at the table
reel_hook: Russia, Ukraine, US: same room again

slides.title: Peace talks in Abu Dhabi
slides.image_prompt: Three empty chairs around a round wooden table with water glasses and closed folders, Abu Dhabi skyline glowing through a large window at dusk
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Russia, Ukraine and the US started two-day talks.
WHY IT MATTERS
Day 1,721 of war, and the sides remain far apart.
FOR YOU
No deal yet: first three-way meeting since February, focused on security guarantees.
slides.body: Russia, Ukraine and the US started two-day talks. Day 1,721 of war, and the sides remain far apart. No deal yet: first three-way meeting since February, focused on security guarantees.
slides.credit: Clint Ian Pinto (CC BY-SA 4.0) via wikimedia

slides.title: Iran war: Trump sees momentum
slides.image_prompt: Military refuelling tanker plane on a misty airfield runway at dawn, empty tarmac and runway lights fading into fog
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Trump met Qatar's PM and saw momentum to end war.
WHY IT MATTERS
Iran calls it 'fake news'; new strikes not ruled out.
FOR YOU
No deal yet, and the US moved 10 tankers out of an English base.
slides.body: Trump met Qatar's PM and saw momentum to end war. Iran calls it 'fake news'; new strikes not ruled out. No deal yet, and the US moved 10 tankers out of an English base.
slides.credit: Senior Airman Keith James (Public domain) via wikimedia

slides.title: COP31 opens in Türkiye
slides.image_prompt: Cracked dry earth meeting a turquoise Mediterranean shoreline, a melting ice cube on a hot stone under a hazy sun
slides.label: SCIENCE
points: WHAT HAPPENED
UN climate summit COP31 opened in Antalya, Türkiye.
WHY IT MATTERS
Guterres warns of 'a new age of climate extremes.'
FOR YOU
It runs to 20 November; expect work on old promises, few big breakthroughs.
slides.body: UN climate summit COP31 opened in Antalya, Türkiye. Guterres warns of 'a new age of climate extremes.' It runs to 20 November; expect work on old promises, few big breakthroughs.

slides.title: Russell Brand gets 10.5 years
slides.image_prompt: Wooden gavel resting on a courtroom bench beside an empty judge's chair, soft grey window light
slides.label: CULTURE
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Russell Brand, 51, sentenced to 10 years, six months.
WHY IT MATTERS
Convicted of rape and sexual assaults involving four women.
FOR YOU
He denies all charges and stays on the sex offenders' register for life.
slides.body: Russell Brand, 51, sentenced to 10 years, six months. Convicted of rape and sexual assaults involving four women. He denies all charges and stays on the sex offenders' register for life.

slides.title: Congress back for final weeks
slides.image_prompt: US Capitol dome at sunset with autumn leaves scattered on the empty marble steps
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
US Congress returned for its final weeks this term.
WHY IT MATTERS
Democrats take control of both chambers in January.
FOR YOU
Anything passed now comes before the January power shift in Washington.
slides.body: US Congress returned for its final weeks this term. Democrats take control of both chambers in January. Anything passed now comes before the January power shift in Washington.

caption:
🕊️ Russia, Ukraine and the US are talking again in Abu Dhabi, first time since February. No deal yet.
✈️ Trump sees momentum on ending the Iran war; Iran says 'fake news', and US tankers left an English base.
🌍 COP31 opened in Antalya: expect work on old promises, not big new deals.
⚖️ Russell Brand sentenced to 10 years and six months.
🏛️ US Congress is back for its last weeks before Democrats take over in January.
